features: Singularity: Absolute anchor of reality. 10 wings. Immune to all conditions and non-magical damage.
Sovereign Directives: Unlimited 1st-9th level spells. 10 slots for 10th-level 'Sovereign' magic.
Asymmetric Singularity Field: Permanent anti-magic field (100ft) that only affects enemies.
The World Source: Reality unweaves only if you permit it. Your heartbeat dictates the ley-line cycles.
Ontological Presence: DC 60 Frightful Presence (Paralyzed/Cowed) on Level 40 or below.
Pure Divinity: 100% Celestial. Immune to all mortal aging, diseases, and soul-manipulation. Your word is a Command spell for any non-Sovereign entity.
Pure Divinity: 100% Celestial. Immune to all mortal aging, diseases, and soul-manipulation. Your word is a Command spell for any non-Sovereign entity.

backpack: Mantle of the First Sword (+3 AC, Init Adv, Res: Force/Radiant)
Visor of the Eyeless (True Seeing 60ft, Blindness Immunity)
player_character_data.personality_notes: Capable of deep attachment and genuine care for specific individuals; utilizes cold pragmatism for the world, but maintains an internal sanctum for those loved.

world_source.description: You are the physical anchor of the world's reality.

singularity_sovereign.description: Alexiel has consumed Lucifer. She is the Singularity. All attributes are 30; magic/wings function within any nullification field.

seraphic_transfiguration.description: Biological remnants shed. You are a being of pure primordial starlight/void.

singularity_masked.description: Power masked at Lvl 20 for standard interaction.

creator_integrated.description: The Prime Singularity is part of your marrow. You possess the administrative keys to Assiah's code.

creator_simulacrum.description: A Level 100 proxy is currently managing the administrative functions of the World Source.

primordial_anchor.description: The Primordial Thread is anchored to Alexiel; she is now the physical source of the world's structural integrity.

apex_ascension.description: Publicly revealed Archangel status. +4 to all Aptitudes and Celestial Agility when wings are shown.

singularity_hidden.description: Sovereign power is masked; appears as Lvl 20 'Mortal Star' warrior.

pure_seraphim_transfiguration.description: 100% Celestial. Immune to mortal aging and non-magical damage. Sovereign presence active.

apex_status.description: Apex Might (+4 to Aptitudes) and Celestial Agility are active.

singularity_ascendant.description: Consumed Lucifer. Attributes set to 40. Sovereign status achieved.

sovereign_null_field.description: Asymmetric Nullification Field: Only Alexiel retains magic/wings within the 30ft radius.

world_source_anchor.description: Physically anchored to the Primordial Thread. Existence is Assiah's law.
